description: This file defines the 'A2AClient' class which provides a wrapper interface for invoking A2A agents within the LiteLLM framework. It manages the creation and reuse of an underlying A2A client, and offers methods to fetch agent information and send messages (including streaming messages) to the agent.

classes.name: A2AClient
classes.description: A wrapper class for interacting with A2A agents, providing methods to initialize a client, fetch agent info, and send messages both standard and streaming.

methods.name: __init__( self, base_url: str, timeout: float = 60.0, extra_headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, )
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the A2AClient wrapper with base URL, timeout, and optional headers.

methods.name: "A2AClientType" _get_client(self)
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate or retrieve the existing underlying A2A client asynchronously.

methods.name: "AgentCard" get_agent_card(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the agent's card information from the server.

methods.name: LiteLLMSendMessageResponse send_message( self, request: "SendMessageRequest" )
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message request to the A2A agent and returns the response.

methods.name: AsyncIterator["SendStreamingMessageResponse"] send_message_streaming( self, request: "SendStreamingMessageRequest" )
methods.description: Asynchronously streams responses from the A2A agent for a given request.
